description.value: Mangos Kitchen Bar is a Latin American restaurant and bar in downtown Vancouver's Howe Street corridor, serving dishes drawn from across the continent — Peruvian ceviche and lomo saltado, Mexican birria tacos, Colombian empanadas, Venezuelan arepas, and Argentine choripán. The venue pairs an extensive cocktail list (premium tequilas, Colombian aguardiente, Peruvian pisco) with a lively events calendar including salsa and bachata dance nights. Outdoor patio seating and a high-energy atmosphere make it a spirited stop in the heart of downtown.
